name: Great Sunthread caster
description: A long, slender caster that weaves a bolt of pale gold light. Quick for its size and very accurate.

name: Dawnweaver caster
description: The principal gun of a House capital ship. A single bolt, grown in a crystal lattice and fired with great care.

name: Moonbeam lance
description: A thin, continuous lance of cold teal light. It cuts rather than batters.

name: Starpiercer
description: A needle of hardened light fired at a fraction of the speed of the stars it is named for. It is the Houses' answer to heavy armour.

name: Silverveil battery
description: Spreads a fine curtain of bursting light across the approaches. Fighters find it hard to fly through.

name: Moonfall torpedo
description: A slow, graceful homing warhead that arrives all at once. The Houses use few of them and miss with fewer.

name: Windarrow rack
description: A single slim homing missile, quick off the rail and light enough for the smallest fighters.

name: Twin windarrow rack
description: A paired rack of windarrow missiles for gunships and heavy fighters.
